thread:
deploy-bot: Starting scheduled curbside traffic shift — routing 5% -> router-v2 (green) in eu-west1 now. Canary endpoints healthy. Release notes: https://redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-21/router-v2 :rocket:

Maya: good. are we doing cookie pinning for session-stickiness?

Jiwon: yes, cookie_persist=enabled for this rollout. adding 5% only to stateless lanes.

Ben: quick check — KV cache warmup for v2 completed? I saw warmup job succeed.

Samir: warmup OK. perf p95 looks same on my local bench.

Taylor: heads up — I'll watch p50/p95 and error budget for the first 10 mins. set me as observer.

deploy-bot: Shift at 5% complete. metrics: latency +1ms, errors unchanged.

Maya: nice. hold for 10m and then bump to 25% if no regressions.

Jiwon: confirming rollout policy: 5 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100 with 10m quiesce at each step. Auto-fallback enabled to router-v1.

Ben: logging note — pinning version label in router config: 
```
router set-weight --env eu-west1 --service frontend --target router-v2 --weight 25 --pin-version "rev-2026-03-21-v2"
```

Samir: if we see an error spike >0.5% or P95 > baseline+30ms, rollback immediate. ops runbook ready.

Taylor: I see a small uptick in 3xx redirects from v2 (session handling). looks within expected.

Maya: can we enable partial drain on blue nodes as green ramps? avoid cold starts.

Jiwon: yes — using graceful-drain with a 60s window. command queued to start at 25% step.

deploy-bot: Next planned bump: 25% at +10m (6790011823). I'll post an update at each step.

oncall-bot: @Maya assigned as primary for 1h after rollout. Pager rules active.

Ben: adding a note to release: "Router v2: improved kernel selection for short sequences, identical semantics, opt-in canary. See perf graphs linked."

Samir: quick sanity check — healthcheck path /_hc returns 200 within 50ms for 95% of probes.

Taylor: 5m in — p95 stable, error rate 0.02%. proceeding to 25% in 2m unless objections. :thumbsup:

Maya: go for it. remind me to remove pin after 24h if stable.

deploy-bot: Initiating 25% shift now. running validation sweep and session-drain.

Jiwon: bump successful. metrics: p50 unchanged, p95 +3ms, errors flat. no rollbacks.

Ben: ops note — temporarily increase BPF window for router-v2 to avoid rebalancing thrash.

Samir: saw one spike at t+7m (external upstream 503), traced to a backing service. not router-related.

Maya: good find, Samir. we should postpone 50% until that upstream's mitigations are confirmed.

Taylor: agree. I'll hold the next step. updated the rollout doc: https://redwood.ai/ops/rollouts/router-v2-notes

deploy-bot: Shift paused at 25% by operator request (Maya). Auto-fallback remains configured.

Maya: marking this as "paused for upstream stabilisation" and will re-evaluate in 30m. please ping in this thread with any anomalies.

Jiwon: added a broadcast to #customer-impact if anything crosses thresholds.

Ben: FYI tagged release notes with the exact pinned revision and changelog.

Samir: will monitor traces and surface anything unusual. thanks all.

Taylor: leaving short playbook in thread: 
1) If errors > 0.5%: run `router set-weight --target router-v1 --weight 100`
2) If latency delta > 30ms: reduce weight to 10% and rerun warmup
3) If upstream fixes confirmed: resume 50% -> 100% with 5m quiesce

Maya: acknowledged. resume decision at 6790011823 + 30m check (est 6790013623).

deploy-bot: Thread pinned to channel for visibility. I'll post automation logs when resume/rollback occurs. :white_check_mark:
